Cleaner links and international saved articles.

### ✨ Improvements
- Links in notes are plain coloured text; hovering shows a soft highlight instead of an underline.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Saved articles from pages that aren't UTF-8 (Japanese Shift_JIS, EUC-JP, Chinese GBK, Western Windows-1252) are decoded properly instead of filling with `�`. Link previews get the same fix.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.4.12...v0.4.13](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.4.12...v0.4.13)
